items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Wade was a, Wade was a, there was another trumpet player... he was with Waring quite a while. With Fred Waring, he was strictly a, he was strictly a gag man.

ctx.x: He was responsible for giving him his start with this band. I don't know, I don't think it was Harold Kemp. I think it was another one of these singing bands. But, Wade did give me two pictures of when he was with the Dick Solas and once when he was with Harold Kemp. Wade was very close to me. We corresponded. And then he, I think I told you this, that he came down to his sister's, he came down to his sister's anniversary party. Which he told her that he didn't think he was going to be able to get there. And he…
No, no, no, no. You're thinking of, uh, of, uh, Pollock.
